name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms, under which each party may disclose confidential information to the other for a stated purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, term, governing law and party details that the standard terms reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement for providing customers with subscription access to a cloud service.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving a partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement setting uptime targets, support response times and remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for services performed under statements of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement covering the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing software to a customer.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement setting out each party's obligations in a business partnership.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement for handling protected health information under HIPAA.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for a customer's time-limited evaluation of a product.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum that supplements an existing agreement with terms for AI services, inputs and outputs.
